newsitem.title: UK: Go-Ahead indicated up five pct on results.
newsitem.headline: Go-Ahead indicated up five pct on results.

text.p: Shares in Go-Ahead Group Plc were indicated 25p higher at 516 on Friday after the UK bus and coach group said its pre-tax pre-exceptional profits surged 82 percent during the first half.
The company posted pre-tax pre-exceptional profits of 12.2 million stg, which was better than many had expected, dealers said.
The shares have risen for the past five of six sessions ahead of the results and are now within striking distance of their January 31 peak of 520p, one noted.
